title: bupleurum falcatum var. diversifolium
intro: Bupleurum falcatum var. diversifolium, commonly known as Japanese Thorny Bupleurum, is a variety of the Bupleurum falcatum plant, which is a species of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, which help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of the common cold and flu. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum falcatum var. diversifolium include clearing heat and toxicities, resolving dampness, and calming the spirit, making it a valuable herb in traditional Chinese medicine. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as saikosaponins, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
